_about: How each client's inboxes are set up in Smartlead. smartlead_account = which SMARTLEAD_API_KEY_* holds them (Precise Leads and Melior share one). smartlead_client_id files the inbox under a Smartlead client (Melior = 12256 inside the Precise Leads account; null = none). signature = HTML with {first_name} {last_name} {full_name} {title} {company} {website} {email}; empty = signatures are not touched until the team supplies one. title/company/website fill those placeholders. Edit freely; no code change needed.
